property_summary: The owner can always withdraw all contract balance via withdrawAll, so after sendMoney the contract balance must be zero if the owner calls withdrawAll.
After calling sendMoney, the owner can call withdrawAll to send the entire contract balance to the owner, so the contract balance after withdrawAll is always zero.

After calling sendMoney with value v, the owner can call withdrawAll to transfer the entire contract balance to the owner, so the contract balance after withdrawAll is zero regardless of the sendMoney parameters.
After any sendMoney call, when the owner calls withdrawAll, the contract balance becomes zero because the correct implementation transfers all balance.
After calling sendMoney, the owner can call withdrawAll to transfer the entire contract balance to the owner, so the contract balance after withdrawAll is always zero.
After a call to sendMoney, the owner's balance equals the previous balance plus the value sent, because send reverts on failure while send does not propagate the revert.
After sendMoney to any address with value equal to the contract's balance, the contract's balance becomes zero.
After sendMoney, the contract's balance decreases by exactly the value sent.
After a call to sendMoney, the contract's depositsCount is not incremented when the call fails, but when it succeeds it is incremented.
After sendMoney to any address with value equal to the contract's balance, the contract's balance becomes zero.
After calling sendMoney, the contract's balance remains unchanged when the call sends zero value.
After calling sendMoney with any non-zero _value, the contract's balance decreases exactly by _value on the reference but not on the bug.
After calling sendMoney, the contract's address(this).balance before and after the call are the same when _value is 0, regardless of the other parameters.
After calling sendMoney with onlyOwner, the owner address remains unchanged regardless of _target, _value, and _data.

After calling sendMoney, the contract's balance decreases by _value when _value is non-zero and the call succeeds, but the buggy version always sends zero value, so the balance change is not equal to _value.
